headline: Iranian videos call for the assassination of Barron Trump – what's behind it?
lead: Iranian state media threatens the U.S. president's son with death. There is reportedly even a murder plot against the son of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
seo_title: Iranian threat videos: Barron Trump and Netanyahu's son in focus
social_title: Iranian videos call for the assassination of Barron Trump – what's behind it?
print_title: Iran calls for the assassination of Barron Trump
print_subtitle: Benjamin Netanyahu's son also apparently came under Tehran's scrutiny
summary_bullets_en: An Iranian AI-generated video threatens Barron Trump with death and suggests methods to bypass his security detail.
The video's content is mostly based on publicly available information, offering no concrete evidence of actual danger.
Similar threats have reportedly been made against Yair Netanyahu, the son of the Israeli Prime Minister.
key_questions_de: Wie gefährlich sind die Drohungen gegen Barron Trump wirklich?
Welche Rolle spielt das KI-generierte Video in der iranischen Propaganda?
Warum nimmt Iran prominente Söhne ins Visier?

original_de.headline: Iranische Videos rufen zur Ermordung von Barron Trump auf – was steckt dahinter?
original_de.lead: In iranischen Staatsmedien wird dem Sohn des amerikanischen Präsidenten mit dem Tod gedroht. Gegen den Sohn des israelischen Ministerpräsidenten Benjamin Netanyahu soll es gar ein Mordkomplott gegeben haben.

body.text: Unlike his father and his older half-siblings, Barron Trump leads a secluded life. The 20-year-old son of U.S. President Donald Trump has not yet held any public office in his father's administration. He studies at New York University (NYU) and, according to media reports, moves only with Secret Service accompaniment. With good reason: the president's son has been publicly threatened repeatedly in recent years. Now Barron Trump has come into the crosshairs of the Iranian regime.

Under the title «Where Barron Trump Should Be Killed,» Iranian state media recently published a nearly three-minute AI-generated video. The message: Iranian state media claims Barron Trump is vulnerable despite extensive personal protection. According to the video, his weaknesses are his isolation, his digital communication, and his small circle of friends. Anyone who acts cleverly could get close to Barron Trump personally, and this, the video asserts, has already been achieved by at least one person.

«This video is the result of unprecedented infiltration,» the video states at the very beginning. «It was provided to us by a young woman who succeeded in overcoming the strictest security protocols of the U.S. Secret Service and sitting opposite Barron for a private meeting on the 58th floor of Trump Tower.» However, the AI-generated video provides no evidence that such an encounter actually took place.

Instead, it reconstructs Barron Trump's alleged daily routine, including at an NYU center in Washington. The video further states that the upper floors contain four-person suites and single rooms. It claims that access to the students living there is the first step to entering Barron Trump's orbit. The video says that due to personal protection, the president's son is not directly accessible, but only through his personal circle.

The video argues that individuals from his circle of friends and acquaintances, especially his digital contacts, represent a weak point through which one could gradually gain access to his social environment. The video's logic is: first infiltrate Barron Trump's network, then advance into his immediate vicinity via trusted contacts.

However, the information about Barron Trump mentioned in the video is by no means as exclusive as it appears at first glance. Vanity Fair had already reported that Barron Trump studies at NYU in Washington, previously lived in Trump Tower in New York, and was accompanied by a motorcade of black SUVs during his studies there.

Barron Trump's fondness for video games is also not intelligence information, but publicly known. However, it is not proven that his current accounts or communication channels described in the video are actually correct. The Iranian threat video against Barron Trump therefore provides no new insights into the life of the president's son. But it holds out the prospect of a bounty in the double-digit millions, raising the question: Are he and other members of Donald Trump's family now at greater risk than before?

«Whether the Iranians can actually pose a danger to Barron Trump depends primarily on their capabilities,» says Walter Posch. The Islamic scholar and Iran expert from the National Defense Academy in Vienna specializes in the political system, security apparatuses, and strategic decision-making of the Islamic Republic. «I am rather skeptical that the Iranians could succeed in this endeavor, because the state as a whole is under very strong pressure.»

The production effort for such a clip is rather low thanks to modern AI video generators. Comparable material can be created in just a few hours of work. Iran expert Posch interprets the video as a sign of nervousness and less as a sign of offensive action. «The Iranians want to make it clear once again: We are very strong, and we can do this. While this is more propaganda than an operation, the threat should still be taken seriously.»

It reportedly got even more precarious for Yair Netanyahu. About six months ago, the son of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu unexpectedly returned to Israel from the U.S. – apparently to seek safety. Benjamin Netanyahu recently stated in a phone interview with the government-affiliated Channel 14: «Iran has targeted one of my sons. Iran tried to kill, to assassinate one of my sons.»

Israeli intelligence services had already learned in December that Iran planned to kill Yair in Florida, according to the U.S. media outlet Newsmax. Yair Netanyahu, known as a provocative right-wing activist on social media, spent most of his time there until last winter. According to media reports, intelligence services assume that Iranian agents were already on site in the Miami area and had been monitoring the movements of the prime minister's son.

However, Iran expert Posch doubts that the assassination of Yair Netanyahu is among the priorities of the Iranian regime – also for strategic reasons: «Anyone who knows Benjamin Netanyahu knows that attacks on his person or his family make him even more determined and an even tougher opponent than he already is.»

Other goals are likely to be more important to the leadership in Tehran: to unsettle the adversaries the U.S. and Israel and to build psychological pressure. The message: Even the closest circle of the world's best-protected politicians is within Iran's reach. At the same time, the regime in Tehran demonstrates its capacity to act to its own population – at a time when it is fighting for its own survival.
